Welcome to my website!

Hi there! My name is Ethan Larimore and I'm a Junior at Rice University majoring in Statistics and Sport Analytics. At Rice, I'm fortunate to work directly with our D1 Baseball team as an Analytics Intern and regularly compete in analytics competitions. This fall, I'll be a research assistant at [Professor Scott Powers' Lab](https://saberpowers.com/lab/), which focuses on projects in sport analytics.

In my free time, I enjoy playing pickup basketball, exploring Houston's restaurant scene, and lion dancing.
